integrity: The proof conditions on the uniform root split, applies total covariance to two independent recursive subtrees, and evaluates the only between-split term from four boundary leaf-mean deviations. The harmonic contribution cancels exactly against the accumulated smaller-tree covariances. An exact-rational checker exhaustively enumerates every insertion permutation through size nine and independently replays the moment recurrences through size three hundred.
scientific_limitations: The formulas use the random-permutation binary-search-tree model and are not asserted for biased or median-of-sample pivot rules.
The least-squares slope is a projection coefficient, not a conditional-expectation or causal statement.
Classical marginal leaf and path-length formulas are background; the claimed contribution is their exact mixed covariance and its cancellation mechanism.
title: Random-BST leaf abundance has an exact negative search-cost covariance
